channel.title: Cyber Threat Wall — New KEVs
channel.description: Vulnerabilities newly appearing in CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.

item.title: CVE-2026-84869 — ConnectWise ScreenConnect
item.description: Threat Signal 69. ConnectWise ScreenConnect contains both an improper privilege management and missing authorization vulnerability that may allow an attacker to file transfer and execution through an active remote sessions without authorization or host confirmation.

item.title: CVE-2026-86060 — MikroTik RouterOS
item.description: Threat Signal 67. MikroTik RouterOS contains an improper neutralization of argument delimiters in a command vulnerability which allows an attacked to change the trusted RouterOS policy mask, leading to privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2026-67277 — MikroTik RouterOS
item.description: Threat Signal 67. MikroTik RouterOS contains a missing authenticaion for critical function vulnerability which allows kernel memory disclosure and denial of service in the btest service.

item.title: CVE-2026-42016 — JFrog Artifactory
item.description: Threat Signal 65. JFrog Artifactory contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that allows leads to privilege escalation attack due to a validation check of the token signature/issuer and not the token’s scope.

item.title: CVE-2026-42018 — JFrog Artifactory
item.description: Threat Signal 62. JFrog Artifactory contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could return an internal anonymous-user token to an unauthenticated caller when anonymous access is disabled, potentially exposing sensitive resources.

item.title: CVE-2026-85706 — GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition
item.description: Threat Signal 49. GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated user to read arbitrary files due to an improper path confinement and missing authentication enforcement in the repository commits API.
